videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: When Garmadon uses his new Super-Weapon to turn Jamakai Village evil, he unwittingly unsettles the balance, allowing the spirit of the Overlord to cross over and possesses his body.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: A great darkness has fallen upon Ninjago as Garmadon’s Super-Weapon has turned it evil but Lloyd and the Ninjas discover that light is more powerful than dark - and the final and ultimate battle is on.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord’s evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas’ search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: Lloyd is free but Pythor and the Overlord are nowhere to be found. However the Ninja have a cryptic clue to their next plan - something called Codename: Arcturus. But what is it?

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: Back in Ninjago it is time for the final battle with the reborn, god-like Overlord. The stakes have never been greater and one ninja must make the ultimate sacrifice to try to stop his reign of destruction

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: Back in Ninjago it is time for the final battle with the reborn, god-like Overlord. The stakes have never been greater and one ninja must make the ultimate sacrifice to try to stop his reign of destruction

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: On the island, Lloyd learns that his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen and when the Ninja meet the playfully deceitful ruler, they realize they are in a tournament where “Only one can remain.”

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: Chen pits everyone against each other in a ludicrous roller skating event called Thunderblade and all contestants team up against the Ninja.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: The Ninja have a secret alliance of elemental fighters, Cole has found Zane and Nya is a spy within Chen’s Kabuki to figure out what nefarious plot Chen is up to.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: Nya has proof of Chen’s plan but he entices the contestants to hunt her down with promises to advance the winner, forcing the Ninja in a race to get to her first.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: After stealing the remaining contestant’s powers, Chen only needs Lloyd’s power to complete the spell and knowing his daughter has feelings for Kai, Chen tries to enlist the Fire Ninja by promising to share secrets about his parents.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: Chen has failed to bring the return of the Serpentine War but Clouse reveals there’s another way – his daughter has the ability to absorb the power of every fighter she comes across, so she can complete the ceremony.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: The Ninja reunite with Wu and turn to the aid of a shrunken Pythor in order to figure out how to defeat the unstoppable Anacondrai.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: The Ninja and fighters discover there’s a strategic location called The Corridor of Elders where they can make their last stand against Chen’s Anacondrai army... but even with the new Destiny Bounty, their forces still aren’t strong enough.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: Kai promises to watch over Lloyd when Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain– but when Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission…

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu’s staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn’t keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: The Ninja hear of another way to learn Airjitzu - from the ghost of Sensei Yang at his haunted temple - but there’s a warning; if you are trapped in it by sunrise, you will become a ghost, too.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: Now that the Ninja know Airjitzu, they get briefed about how the next stage to finding the tomb is to get ‘The Sword of Sanctuary’ from Cloud Kingdom, which can only be reached from the top of the Wailing Alps.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: In Cloud Kingdom, a realm where destinies are written, the Ninja must get the Sword of Sanctuary, a powerful relic that can see past the traps surrounding the tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master – but tensions are high as Moro’s escape from the Cursed …

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: The Ninja now have all the items they need to get to the tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master but before they can figure out the last riddle that leads to the location of the tomb.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: The Ninja use Ronan’s airship to travel to the tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master in an underwater cave under the ocean, only to find out Moro is already there.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: When Moro uses the Realm Crystal to open a portal to the Cursed Realm, ghosts take over the town - but the Ninja, in disguise, manage to get Lloyd to the center of the town and Lloyd steals the crystal…

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: As the ghosts converge around and mobilize the Preeminent into a hulking giant behemoth, the Ninja use Airjitzu to fight the mobile beast in an attempt to slow it down.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: After the defeat of the ghosts and the destruction of the Cursed Realm, the ninja finds themselves famous all over Ninjago.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: With Destiny’s Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny’s Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja breaks him out of jail.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan’s ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.

videos.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
videos.overview: The ninja’s search for Nadakhan’s ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan’s crew is struggling to handle an airship that used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya.
